sources.name: Ant Design and its @rc-component packages
sources.version: antd 6.7.0 @ 0572a24a2ada6021a55d93fceca93a67b2dc6e2f; @rc-component slider 1.2.1, tabs 2.0.0, menu 1.6.2, tree 1.5.3, picker 1.17.0, rate 1.0.1, segmented 1.4.0, switch 1.0.3

provenance.notes: Researched definition in tools/extract/patterns/src/apg-2.mjs. Every binding was checked against the APG page; roles and key names are cross-checked mechanically against apg-skeleton.json and aria-roles.json. Arabic name is an unreviewed translation.

attributes.name: aria-expanded
attributes.on: parent row, or a cell in it

attributes.name: aria-labelledby
attributes.values: IDREF of the visible label; otherwise aria-label

attributes.name: aria-describedby
attributes.values: IDREF of a caption or description

attributes.name: aria-sort
attributes.on: columnheader or rowheader of the sorted column or row

attributes.name: aria-selected
attributes.on: selected gridcell or row; every cell of a selected column
attributes.note: Only when the grid supports selection.

attributes.name: aria-readonly
attributes.on: gridcell whose editing is disabled, or the container when no cell is editable
attributes.note: Never present on a grid that has no editing.

attributes.name: aria-colcount
attributes.note: When some columns are hidden or not in the DOM.

attributes.name: aria-rowcount
attributes.values: total number of rows; -1 when unknown
attributes.note: When some rows are hidden or not in the DOM.

attributes.name: aria-colspan
attributes.note: Only when the container is not an HTML table.

attributes.name: aria-rowspan
attributes.note: Only when the container is not an HTML table.

attributes.name: aria-level
attributes.note: Not listed on the pattern page; defined for row in a treegrid by WAI-ARIA 1.2.

keyboard.action: With cell-only focus, on the first cell that carries aria-expanded: open or close the child rows. Otherwise perform the default action of the cell.
If the focused row has focusable elements, move to the next one; from the last one leave the treegrid to the next focusable element.
Collapsed row: expand it. Expanded row or row without children: move focus to its first cell. Cell: move one cell toward the row end; stay on the last cell.
Expanded row: collapse it. Collapsed row or row without children: nothing. First cell: move focus to the row if rows are focusable, else nothing. Other cell: move one cell toward the row start.
Row: move one row down. Cell: move one cell down. Stay at the bottom.
Row: move one row up. Cell: move one cell up. Stay at the top.
Move focus down by an author-defined number of rows (keeping the column when on a cell); stay in the last row.
Move focus up by an author-defined number of rows (keeping the column when on a cell); stay in the first row.
Row: move to the first row. Cell: move to the first cell of the row.
Row: move to the last row. Cell: move to the last cell of the row.
Row: move to the first row. Cell: move to the cell in the first row of the same column.
Row: move to the last row. Cell: move to the cell in the last row of the same column.
Row: select all cells. Cell: select its column.
Select the row that has or contains focus; with a checkbox column, a shortcut for checking the row.
Row: no change. Cell: extend the selection one cell toward the row end.
Row: no change. Cell: extend the selection one cell toward the row start.
Row: extend the selection to all cells of the next row. Cell: extend one cell down.
Row: extend the selection to all cells of the previous row. Cell: extend one cell up.

focus.entry: Tab focuses the first row or the first cell, depending on whether rows are focusable (an author choice).
focus.exit: Tab from the last focusable element of the row leaves the treegrid.
focus.note: Three focus models: rows only, cells only, or rows first then cells. Cell content follows the grid rules for focusing a cell or the widget inside it, and for entering a cell.

rtlDecisions.question: Do ArrowLeft and ArrowRight move by visual cell or by column index in an RTL grid?
rtlDecisions.apg: Silent. No pattern page mentions right-to-left; keys are described physically (left, right) for a left-to-right layout. Right Arrow moves "one cell to the right".

libraries.behaviour: The grid keyboard delegate resolves the key right of and left of a cell against direction, so movement is visual.
Grid navigation in the composite takes an rtl flag and swaps the horizontal keys.
Data grid keyboard navigation computes left and right targets with isRtl.

rtlDecisions.reason: Columns are laid out from inline-start, so the first column is on the right. Following the APG wording literally (move one cell to the right) and mirroring are the same thing here: the key moves focus in the direction it points.

rtlDecisions.question: Which arrow expands a tree node and which collapses it in RTL?
rtlDecisions.apg: Silent. No pattern page mentions right-to-left; keys are described physically (left, right) for a left-to-right layout. Right arrow opens a closed node, Left arrow closes an open one.

libraries.behaviour: Expansion keys are keyed by direction: rtl expands with ArrowLeft and collapses with ArrowRight.
Tree view expands on ArrowLeft and collapses on ArrowRight when isRtl.
Does not swap: ArrowLeft always collapses or moves to the parent, ArrowRight always expands, although direction is passed for drag positioning.

rtlDecisions.reason: Children are indented toward inline-end and the disclosure chevron points there; the arrow that points into the indentation expands.

data.notes: Note the difference from grid: Control+Home and Control+End keep the column. RTL: ArrowLeft expands a row, enters its cells and moves toward the row end; ArrowRight collapses and moves toward the row start or back to the row. One binding carries both the tree and the cell meaning, so both decisions (tree-expand-collapse, grid-cell-navigation) apply and agree.
